items.text: Dodgers trade Tim Locastro to the Yankees for Drew Finley and cash
Mariners trade Bill Caudill and Darrel Akerfelds to the Athletics for Dave Beard and Bob Kearney
Reds trade Tommy Harper to the Indians for George Culver, Fred Whitfield and Bob Raudman
Cubs trade cash, Bud Tinning and Dick Ward to the Cardinals for Tex Carleton
Cubs trade cash, Ted Kleinhans, Mark Koenig and Harvey Hendrick to the Phillies for Chuck Klein
Pirates buy Ned Hanlon from the Wolverines
Athletics trade cash, Fred Mann, Chippy McGarr and Jocko Milligan to the Cardinals for Bill Gleason and Curt Welch

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
